acceptance: Documented behavior: either an unchanged patch carries the verdict and keeps arming, or the reason it cannot is recorded.
description: Core PR 3545 was rebased six times onto a moving develop; each forced a fresh full review of about 25 minutes and cleared auto-merge, even when the rebase changed no PR content beyond regenerated files. The oracle protocol has a CARRY decision; whether it covers a rebase with an identical patch is not established.
